meaning: Hábil, diestro (especialmente para manejar situaciones).
example: She was adroit at steering the meeting away from a pointless argument.

meaning: Retrospectiva: entender algo solo después de que ocurrió.
example: In hindsight waiting one more week would have been cheaper.

meaning: Sesgo retrospectivo: creer que ya se sabía lo que iba a pasar.
example: The hindsight bias makes old forecasts look more obvious than they were.

meaning: Sopesar opciones, comparar alternativas antes de decidir.
example: We weighed our options for a week before signing anything.

meaning: Compensación: ceder algo para ganar otra cosa.
example: Working shorter hours is a trade-off between income and free time.

meaning: Deliberado, intencional; también deliberar (pensar con cuidado).
example: The decision was slow but deliberate.

meaning: Dar largas, postergar una decisión.
example: He stalled until the deadline solved the problem for him.

meaning: Prematuro: hecho antes del momento adecuado.
example: Closing the file this early feels premature.

meaning: Convincente, atractivo (un argumento, una idea).
example: Her summary was short and compelling.

meaning: Insignificante: tan pequeño que no cambia el resultado.
example: The difference between the two estimates was negligible.

meaning: Valor atípico: un dato muy alejado del resto.
example: One outlier pulled the average up.

meaning: Sesgar, distorsionar un resultado.
example: A small sample can skew the whole comparison.

meaning: Tamaño de la muestra: cantidad de casos observados.
example: With such a small sample size the ranking means little.

meaning: Umbral: límite a partir del cual algo cambia.
example: Sales crossed the threshold we had set for the quarter.

meaning: Empujar suavemente; influir de forma sutil.
example: A plain reminder nudged people to finish the survey.

meaning: Corazonada, intuición visceral.
example: My gut feeling said the numbers were too neat.

meaning: Cuestionar una decisión ya tomada, revisarla de más.
example: Stop second-guessing every choice you make.

meaning: Accidental, secundario: no es lo principal.
example: The extra cost was incidental to the plan.

meaning: Llevar registro de algo, no perderle la pista.
example: I keep track of new words in a single notebook.

meaning: Aplazar, dejar algo para después.
example: Reading one card at a time is easier than putting it off entirely.
